resources.string: Your documents stay on this phone, locked with your fingerprint or PIN.

Unlock cancelled. Tap Unlock to try again.
Too many fingerprint tries. Tap Unlock and use your PIN, pattern or password instead.
Fingerprint is locked. Unlock your phone with your PIN first, then try again.
Hey Buddy couldn\'t open its secure key. Please try unlocking again.
Unlock didn\'t work. Please try again.
Use your fingerprint or PIN to continue

Please give the document a name.
The name is too long. Please use 60 characters or fewer.
The name can\'t contain line breaks or tabs. Please type it on one line.
The name contains hidden formatting characters. Please type the name again.

Hey Buddy keeps your documents locked with your phone\'s security chip. That chip only works when your phone has a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password).\n\nPlease set a screen lock, then come back to Hey Buddy.
Hey Buddy reads the file once and keeps an encrypted copy. It never needs access to your other files.
Preview not available for this PDF. You can still save it.
Saved to your vault. The original file is still in your phone\'s gallery or downloads. Delete it there if you want it only in Hey Buddy.
Hey Buddy can only store photos (JPEG, PNG, WEBP) and PDF files. Please choose a different file.
This file is larger than 20 MB. Please choose a smaller file.
This image seems to be damaged. Please choose a different file.
Hey Buddy couldn\'t read this file. Please choose it again.
Your vault locked. Unlock it and try again.
Please confirm it\'s you to save. Tap Save to try again.
Your phone is out of storage space. Free up some space and try again.
Something went wrong. Your document was not saved. Please try again.
